sentences.text: By this application under Section 439 CrPC the petitioner, namely, Parameswar Page No.# 2/2 Kshetriya @ Parameswar Khatriya is seeking bail in Bijni P.S. Case No.57/2023 registered under Sections 376/511 IPC read with Section 8 of the POCSO Act, wherein, he was arrested on 11.04.2023 and since then, he is in custody.

During the deliberation of the matter, Mr. M. P. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor,
Assam submitted that police after investigation of said Bijni P.S. Case No.57/2023 has already submitted the charge-sheet on 20.04.2023 vide charge- sheet No.47/2023.
In view of the above, the petitioner may approach the appropriate Court for his regular bail in said Bijni P.S. Case No.57/2023, noted above.
With the above observation and direction, this bail application of the petitioner, stands disposed of.
